prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: unique stellar intensity texture for Fidelity. Create an independent grayscale equirectangular photospheric gas map for 61-cygni-a, a 4400 K K dwarf of radius 0.665 solar radii. Exact 2:1 landscape aspect ratio. Full frame planar latitude-longitude map, seamless east-west edges; no sphere, no perspective, no limb darkening or global lighting gradients. Fine mottled convective gas intensity, a few irregular subtle darker magnetic patches, all morphology invented; mostly hydrogen/helium partly ionized gas with cool-star molecular opacity. Independent morphology, no copied observed Sun or other star map. Not terrain, no rock, lava, solid ground, field lines, labels, borders or text. Moderate grayscale contrast for emissive tinting in app; not calibrated observation.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: hypothetical near-photosphere observer scene for Fidelity. Independent conceptual 61-cygni-a 4400 K K dwarf, 0.665 solar radii. Exact 16:9 landscape image. Camera freely floating at twice the stellar photospheric radius from centre, facing the star. Geometric angular diameter 60 degrees at nominal horizontal field of view120 degrees: circular bright photospheric core should occupy exactly one third of full image width, centered, with only a thin subtle glow outside it. Black space around circle. Warm ivory softly amber emissive gas appearance, less orange hue; fine invented gas convection and a few sparse dark magnetic patches, not lava or rock. Lower exposure preserves gas intensity details. Hydrogen/helium partly ionized photosphere, no solid ground, landing, foreground, clouds like a planet, spacecraft, horizons, field lines, text or labels. Binary companion outside arbitrary viewing direction; no unconfirmed planet. Physically motivated artistic colour/exposure, not calibrated real-colour imagery, no epoch-registered spots. Never copy the Sun or another body's map.

bodies.nativeSurface: Native Gaia 2025 image resolves the two stars as point sources, not photospheric geography. No resolved photospheric map found in checked primary sources. September2026 third companion remains a candidate with host A versus B unresolved.
measured: Kervella2008 CHARA/FLUOR K-prime interferometry limb-darkened angular diameters A1.775±0.013mas/B1.581±0.022mas. Disc size measurement does not resolve gas-cell geography.

Gaia special calibration image observed2025-01-10, released2025-01-15. North up/east left, A north of B. False colour represents intensity only; diffraction and background points are not photospheric structure or planets.
modelled: Kervella2008 radii A0.665±0.005/B0.595±0.008Rsun from angular size and adopted parallax. BVRI surface-brightness temperatures A4400±100/B4040±80K, equations10/11. K-band limb-darkening lookup rounded4400/4000K is not a separate temperature measurement.
